dedupe_keys.name: core analysis code for population exposure flood vulnerability and migration regime classification

description: The project author publishes version 2.0.0 of analysis code for annual population exposure, flood vulnerability and migration-regime classification. Zenodo provides one software archive free under the MIT licence. The description identifies steps to reconstruct population surfaces, extract extreme-rainfall metrics, attribute exposure change to population growth and flood expansion, and summarise basin-level vulnerability. It adds preprocessed migration inputs and documentation from a research-code review. These functions can inform demographic and vulnerability components in flood-risk or service-demand simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workflow. Coverage depends on the supplied catchments and population inputs; no universal asset inventory is included. Annual exposure attribution is model dependent, and classification does not by itself explain why people move. External inputs and code execution remain unverified. No archive was downloaded or result reproduced.
